This is original audio for a cozy dark-fantasy comedy, 2D quarter-view castle-defense game. It must be new material, not an imitation of any artist, franchise, existing song, or copyrighted melody.

Compose an original instrumental game soundtrack lasting about 120 seconds. A 128 BPM D minor final-battle and ending theme for a demon castle earning its future: deep ceremonial drums, low strings, restrained brass, struck bronze, bassoon, and an original noble castle motif that can carry tense final combat and a hard-won epilogue. Weighty, bittersweet, quietly triumphant, and loopable without a hard cadence. Keep the arrangement readable under frequent combat sound effects. No vocals, spoken words, choir syllables, or recognizable samples. Build a coherent arc without a hard ending. Keep the opening and final two seconds texturally compatible so they can be crossfaded into a seamless loop.
